nodes.label:
Mentor Registration
Opens
nodes.title: Mentor Registration Opens
nodes.info: Mentor sign-up for the term opens first, before any student registration link is shared.

nodes.label:
Mentors Confirm
Availability
nodes.title: Mentors Confirm Availability
nodes.info: Each mentor confirms which specific sessions they can attend, per mentor availability tracking from Chapter 9.

nodes.label:
System Calculates Capacity
(Mentors × 3)
nodes.title: System Calculates Capacity (Mentors x 3)
nodes.info: Confirmed mentor count is multiplied by the 3:1 ratio to set the hard student registration capacity limit.

nodes.label:
Student Registration
Opens at That Capacity
nodes.title: Student Registration Opens at That Capacity
nodes.info: The online registration form now accepts sign-ups only up to the calculated limit.

nodes.label:
Is Capacity
Reached?
nodes.title: Is Capacity Reached?
nodes.info: The registration system checks this automatically on every new sign-up attempt.

nodes.label:
Student Registers
Normally
nodes.title: Student Registers Normally
nodes.info: Confirmation email sent immediately, per the registration confirmation process.

nodes.label:
Student Joins the
Waiting List
nodes.title: Student Joins the Waiting List
nodes.info: Added to the waiting list signup in order, notified automatically if a spot opens.

nodes.label:
Capacity Re-Calculated Whenever
Mentor Count Changes
nodes.title: Capacity Re-Calculated Whenever Mentor Count Changes
nodes.info: A new mentor joining, or one dropping out, immediately updates the capacity and can move waiting-list families in.
